description: Review and update application documentation to match current implementation.
name: update application documentation

configJson.prompt: Review {application}'s current codebase state and update all documentation in the docs/ directory to accurately reflect the current implementation. Update API references, architecture docs, and any feature documentation. Do not create new documentation files that don't already exist — only update existing ones.

configJson.args: {application} docs/ — rewrite every Markdown file under docs/ in place, saving each humanized version back over its own file; do not return the rewrites as chat output
{application} docs/ — correct every inaccuracy you confirm; this is the explicit update request the skill requires
